description: Returns the link where the person books a seat at a Siena dinner on sienasociety.com. It books nothing and charges nothing. On the website the person signs up or signs in, answers six short questions the first time, and pays for the seat. Never ask for card details or personal data in chat.

dinner_id.description: The dinner id from list_upcoming_dinners, for example "london-2026-11-05". A Thursday date such as "2026-11-05" also works.

name: start_booking

booking_status.description: open: a seat can be booked now. not_open_yet: booking opens on the Wednesday two weeks before. closed: booking closed on the Tuesday before.

booking_url.description: Null when the dinner is not open to book.

title: Start a Siena booking
